title: How 1 Preseason Decision Reveals the TRUTH About Cleveland's Quarterback Future
description:
Todd Monken announced Deshaun Watson will start the Browns' first preseason game against the Bears, with Shedeur Sanders getting the nod in Week 2 against Buffalo. But this isn't a decision—it's a delay. We break down what Watson's first start since his Achilles injury really means, why Sanders can't pull away from a 30-year-old coming off two years of injuries and ineffectiveness, and how this preseason reveals the truth about Cleveland's quarterback future. Plus, the Nick Chubb reunion that makes too much sense but probably won't happen, the ghosts of 27 years of failed QB competitions, and why the $230M Watson contract continues to haunt every decision this franchise makes.
